claims.text: Chairman Andre Carson addressed the two witnesses by name and title in his opening remarks at the 17 May 2022 hearing: 'Under Secretary Moultrie, Mr. Bray, thank you for coming today.' Bray appeared as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.

label: Scott W. Bray
narrative: Scott W. Bray is the serving naval intelligence officer who answered for the Navy's own reporting and video material on the record at the 17 May 2022 hearing, the first open congressional hearing on this subject in over fifty years. Like the Moultrie node, this one is deliberately incomplete: it carries what the transcript establishes and nothing more. His career and tenure dates have not been researched, and a later pass should treat the node as unfinished.
